name: In 'n Out Barks
description:
When a log is stripped the bark wont disapear this time.

Each wood type have it's own inner & outer bark.

With the inner bark, more softer, you can use it for a weak source of food, but still food.

The outer, more dry, can be use to create fire, or cook food in early game.

name: Ruby Update
description:
Ruby were initialy planned as a trading currency with villager.

As we know, emerald was choosen, du to its shape which isn't similar to any other ore texture.

But, time has changed, it's time to re-introduce them into the game.
